name: smartlogix-order-automation
notes: Prepared architecture only. Receives Shopify order webhooks via secure endpoint, validates order data, checks availability, persists to Supabase idempotently, updates fulfillment, and triggers notifications. No paid services connected.

nodes.name: Shopify Order Webhook
nodes.notes: Inbound Shopify event forwarded only after HMAC verification in server endpoint.

nodes.name: Validate & Dedupe
nodes.notes: Validate payload and reject duplicates via idempotency key/external event id.

nodes.name: Check Availability
nodes.notes: Read/lock inventory state via transactional RPC.

nodes.name: Notify
nodes.notes: Send notification only if Gmail configured; otherwise create in-app alert.
